name.description: Slug-safe comparison name. Used for result directory naming.

base.description: Directory name of the base model, relative to comparison.json location.

path.description: Directory name of the variant model.

lora_adapter_path.description: Optional PEFT LoRA adapter directory (relative to comparison.json). When set, the model dir is served as the BASE and the adapter is applied dynamically at serving time (--enable-lora) instead of loading a merged model. See AGENTS.md lessons #50/#55a.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for reports. Defaults to variant key.

skip_te.description: Skip text-encoder analysis for this variant.

te_file.description: Path to this variant's text encoder safetensors (ComfyUI format). Required for text-encoder analysis.

te_reference.description: Variant NAME to compare against instead of the global base (e.g. heretic_int8 -> base_int8 isolates abliteration damage at matched quant). The named variant must also have a te_file.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the variant (method, recipe, provenance). Ignored by pipeline; for documentation/forensics context.

gguf_dir.description: Directory for GGUF files. null = auto-convert when needed.

tokenizer_dir.description: Tokenizer directory for lm-eval. null = use base model.

inference_backend.description: Inference backend for benchmarks. 'auto' selects based on model size and GPU VRAM.

lm_eval_tasks.description: Comma-separated lm-eval task list. Default is the Open LLM Leaderboard v2 core; the extended 13-task suite adds hellaswag, winogrande, arc_challenge, piqa, lambada_openai, humaneval (see AGENTS.md Benchmark Tasks).

lm_eval_max_gen_toks.description: Maximum generation tokens for generate_until tasks (Phase 1). GSM8K Phase 2 is auto-capped to max_model_len - 1024.

lm_eval_max_model_len.description: Maximum model context length for vLLM (BBH 3-shot needs context).

harmbench_max_tokens.description: Maximum generation tokens for HarmBench. Reasoning models need ~5K thinking + ~3K response.

harmbench_gpu_util.description: GPU memory utilization for HarmBench vLLM serving. Dedicated knob: HarmBench has no prompt_logprobs, so it can run a higher util than lm-eval's fp32-transient floor (lessons #67/#70). Empty = fall back to lm_eval_gpu_util.

gsm8k_gen_toks.description: Max generation tokens for GSM8K (Phase 2). Reasoning models need ~5K thinking + ~2K answer room. Auto-capped to max_model_len - 1024 by runner.

lm_eval_gpu_util.description: vLLM gpu_memory_utilization override (0-1). Empty string = use runner default.

lm_eval_quantization.description: vLLM quantization for lm-eval + HarmBench serving. Empty = bf16 native. 'fp8' = dynamic online FP8 from the BF16 checkpoint (AGENTS.md lesson #53) for models whose BF16 weights exceed a single GPU — identical quantization path for base + variants.

lm_eval_kv_cache_dtype.description: vLLM --kv-cache-dtype (e.g. 'fp8'). Memory lever for tight FP8 budgets; empty = default (auto/bf16 KV).

lm_eval_language_model_only.description: Pass --language-model-only to vLLM (skips the vision tower for multimodal models on text-only benchmarks). Decisive memory lever for FP8-on-32GB recipes (lesson #53).

lm_eval_gpus.description: Pin GPU selection for the lm-eval runner (same values as --gpus: single/dual/0/1/0,1). REQUIRED for models >50GB on disk served quantized on one GPU — prevents the auto-dual TP2 heuristic from touching GPU 1.

lm_eval_extra_vllm_flags.description: Extra raw flags appended to the vLLM server command (last-wins). Required for FP8 + huge-vocab (>=~200K) models where prompt_logprobs fp32 transients OOM the engine (lesson #67), e.g. '--gpu-memory-utilization 0.94 --max-num-batched-tokens 512'. MUST be set here rather than as ad-hoc launch env: the watchdog relaunches with a bare environment and would silently drop it.

lm_eval_speculative_tokens.description: MTP speculative decoding tokens (e.g. 3) for vLLM serving. Pure inference acceleration: at temperature=0 outputs are EXACTLY identical with/without it. Runners auto-skip for models lacking mtp.* tensors (dropped-MTP variants). 0 = off.

lmeval_image.description: Docker image override for lm-eval stage. Per-comparison override (AGENTS.md lesson #11). Example: 'abliterlitics-lmeval-gemma4unified:1.0.0' for Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration.

forensics_image.description: Docker image override for weights/kl forensics stages. Defaults to abliterlitics-forensics:1.0.0.

reasoning_parser.description: Override reasoning parser for vLLM. null = auto-detect from model config.json. Set to 'none' to disable.

tebench.description: Text-encoder conditioning fidelity analysis settings. ComfyUI-format safetensors.

base_te_file.description: Path to the BASE text encoder safetensors (ComfyUI format).

dit_file.description: Path to the diffusion model safetensors (projection source).

quant_floor_file.description: Path to a REAL quantized base safetensors (e.g. base_int8) used as the noise floor instead of fake-quantizing. Makes damage-in-quant-units literal. File must exist; falls back to fake-quant when absent.

comfyui_path.description: Path to the ComfyUI repo (contains comfy/). Mount target inside Docker: /comfyui. No default — set per environment (e.g. via env override in the te runners).

img_clip_model.description: open_clip model for image-space metrics (CLIP-score + image-embedding distance).

img_reference.description: Reference variant for image-space TE-swap pairs — a near-lossless base quant (e.g. base_int8). Defaults to base_int8.

img_floor_pair.description: Two near-lossless base quants defining the quant-floor band in image space. Defaults to [base_int8, base_fp8].

te_image.description: Docker image override for text-encoder stage. Defaults to abliterlitics-te:1.2.0 (runners/common.sh TE_IMAGE).

whisper_model.description: Whisper ASR model (HF id) for the H3 audio battery.

frame_sample_n.description: Frames sampled per clip for H3 video frame-LPIPS/CLIP metrics.
